articles.title: Not Even Born in '98: How 20-Year-Old Ben Gannon-Doak Electrified Scotland's Historic World Cup Return
articles.summary: Scotland hadn't won a men's World Cup match since 1990 — before their star winger was born. Ben Gannon-Doak, 20, overcame three major injuries to ignite a nervy 1-0 victory over Haiti with raw passion and skill.

articles.title: National Security vs. AI Access: Why the US Forced Anthropic to Block Its Most Powerful Models Globally
articles.summary: The Trump administration ordered Anthropic to bar all foreign nationals from using its cutting-edge Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models, citing security risks. The move escalates a feud over military use and export controls.
